findings.body: The integration test lists only circles created by the caller, so every asserted member count is 1 and every `isAdmin` value is true. Hardcoding those two values would pass while giving incorrect summaries to members who joined a circle. Add a real API and database case with a non-admin member and multiple memberships.
findings.title: Not done: joined-member list summary integration test

findings.body: The page-two assertion checks only that one item exists. It would pass if the list were sorted incorrectly, including when equal creation timestamps are ordered without the ruled ID tie-breaker. Assert the circle IDs returned on each page, including a timestamp tie.
findings.title: Not done: newest-first pagination integration test

findings.body: The parser accepts any safe integer as `page`, but multiplying a large page by `limit` can produce an offset beyond Prisma's supported integer range. A syntactically valid request can therefore return a server error instead of a validation response. Bound the computed offset before calling `findMany`.
findings.title: Reject page values whose offset Prisma cannot accept
